item.title: Flournoy, Franklin top NFL's most cost-effective WRs in 2025
item.description: Dallas Cowboys receiver Ryan Flournoy and Denver Broncos receiver Troy Franklin emerged as the most cost-effective wide receivers of the 2025 NFL season.

item.title: The Charles undergoes 18th-century glam makeover
item.description: The Charles, a Dallas restaurant established in 2018, has unveiled a redesigned interior and a refreshed menu featuring expanded wood-fired culinary offerings and 18th-century Italian elegance.

item.title: Survey finds Texas public spaces that most influence home-buying decisions
item.description: A survey of 3,013 homebuyers found that public spaces such as parks and trails significantly influence the desirability of Texas neighborhoods, with six specific parks and trail systems identified as being particularly important to residents.

item.title: Fort Worth mansion near “Landman” filming site lists for $11.9M
item.description: This luxury residence in Fort Worth features four bedrooms, seven bathrooms, a hidden wine room, private movie theater, elevator, indoor gym, Gaggenau appliances, Bulthaup cabinetry, a heated and cooled pool, and a Tesla battery backup system.

item.title: Texas 12th in U.S. for scam frequency and financial losses
item.description: Texas ranks 12th in the nation for scam frequency and financial impact, with residents losing an average of $43.19 per person.

item.title: Texas is America’s least ghosted state, Valentine's data reveals
item.description: Texans are less likely to experience ghosting than other Americans, with only 3 in 100,000 Texans searching for answers related to ghosting, compared to 21 times higher in states like Maine.

item.title: Taylor Swift's 'Opalite' video sparks a viral hair trend
item.description: Taylor Swift's new "Opalite" music video, featuring a cropped brunette bob hairstyle, has triggered a surge in online beauty searches for dark hair dyes and bob styles.

item.title: Tanglewood Resort starts silent book club at Tower Whiskey Bar
item.description: Tanglewood Resort in Pottsboro, Texas has launched a monthly Silent Book Club at its Tower Whiskey Bar, offering a free and open to the public event for book lovers to read and connect in a cozy atmosphere with a view of Lake Texoma.

item.title: LaundroLab launches in DFW with 'free laundry day'
item.description: LaundroLab has opened its first DFW locations in Mesquite and Grand Prairie, and will celebrate with "Free Laundry Day" events on Feb. 15 and Feb. 16.

item.title: President’s Day sales 2026: Apple, Keurig, Dyson and more
item.description: We combed through the noise to find standout President’s Day sales this year. Here's where to shop Apple, Keurig, Dyson and more.
